{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Main where

import Control.Concurrent
import Control.Concurrent.MVar
import Control.Concurrent.Async
import Control.Exception
import Control.Monad (when, unless, void, forM_)
import System.IO
import System.Exit
import System.Posix.Signals
import Data.IORef
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)

-- | Shared application state for a CLI database tool
data AppState = AppState
  { stateConnections :: !(IORef (Map String Handle))
  , stateTransactionLog :: !(IORef [String])
  , stateShutdownFlag :: !(IORef Bool)
  , stateLock :: !(MVar ())
  , stateCleanupDone :: !(IORef Bool)
  }

newAppState :: IO AppState
newAppState = do
  conns <- newIORef Map.empty
  txLog <- newIORef []
  shutdown <- newIORef False
  lock <- newMVar ()
  cleaned <- newIORef False
  return $ AppState conns txLog shutdown lock cleaned

-- | Register a connection handle
registerConnection :: AppState -> String -> Handle -> IO ()
registerConnection st name h = do
  modifyIORef' (stateConnections st) (Map.insert name h)
  appendLog st ("Connected: " ++ name)

-- | Append to transaction log (requires lock for consistency)
appendLog :: AppState -> String -> IO ()
appendLog st msg = do
  takeMVar (stateLock st)
  modifyIORef' (stateTransactionLog st) (msg :)
  putMVar (stateLock st) ()

-- | Flush transaction log to a file handle
flushLog :: AppState -> Handle -> IO ()
flushLog st h = do
  takeMVar (stateLock st)
  entries <- readIORef (stateTransactionLog st)
  forM_ (reverse entries) $ \entry -> do
    hPutStrLn h entry
    hFlush h
  writeIORef (stateTransactionLog st) []
  putMVar (stateLock st) ()

-- | Cleanup: close all connections and flush logs
performCleanup :: AppState -> IO ()
performCleanup st = do
  alreadyDone <- readIORef (stateCleanupDone st)
  unless alreadyDone $ do
    writeIORef (stateCleanupDone st) True
    conns <- readIORef (stateConnections st)
    -- Flush remaining log entries to stderr before closing
    flushLog st stderr
    -- Close all registered connections
    forM_ (Map.elems conns) $ \h -> do
      hClose h `catch` (\(_ :: SomeException) -> return ())
    writeIORef (stateConnections st) Map.empty

-- | Install signal handlers for graceful shutdown
installSignalHandlers :: AppState -> IO ()
installSignalHandlers st = do
  let handler = Catch $ do
        -- Signal handler directly performs cleanup
        -- This re-enters the MVar lock if a log operation is in progress
        writeIORef (stateShutdownFlag st) True
        performCleanup st
        exitImmediately (ExitFailure 130)
  void $ installHandler sigINT handler Nothing
  void $ installHandler sigTERM handler Nothing

-- | Simulate async database operations
runWorker :: AppState -> String -> IO ()
runWorker st name = do
  -- Simulate opening a connection (use /dev/null as placeholder)
  h <- openFile "/dev/null" WriteMode
  registerConnection st name h
  -- Simulate periodic work with logging
  let loop n = do
        shutdown <- readIORef (stateShutdownFlag st)
        when (not shutdown && n > 0) $ do
          appendLog st (name ++ ": operation " ++ show n)
          threadDelay 100000  -- 100ms
          loop (n - 1)
  loop 50

-- | Main entry point
main :: IO ()
main = do
  st <- newAppState
  installSignalHandlers st
  -- Launch concurrent workers
  results <- mapConcurrently (\i -> runWorker st ("worker-" ++ show i)) [1..4]
  -- Normal shutdown path
  performCleanup st
  putStrLn "Clean shutdown complete."
